
```{python}
import pandas as pd
import pyvista as pv

from pathlib import Path

from majordome import plot_xy
```


```{python}
root_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
data_path = root_path / "reference/SandiaPropaneJet/SANDC3H8.JET"
data_prof = data_path / "vel/velstat"
```

```{python}
def read_profile(
        prof: Path,
        names: list[str] | None = None
    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """ Read a velocity profile from a text file. """
    df = pd.read_csv(
        prof,
        delimiter = r"\s+",
        header    = None,
        comment   = "C",
        names     = names
    )
    return df
```


```{python}
names = ["x/D", "y/D", "U mean", "Urms"]
df = read_profile(data_prof / "p00v.txt", names=names)
df
```

```{python}
names = ["x/D", "y/D", "U mean", "V mean", "Urms", "Vrms", "UV"]
p = plot_xy()

for f in data_prof.glob(r"p*v.jet.txt"):
    df = read_profile(f, names=names)
    x = df["y/D"]
    # y = df["U mean"]
    # y = df["V mean"]
    y = (df["U mean"]**2 + df["V mean"]**2)**0.5

    p.add_curve(x, y, label=f"{f.stem}")

p.legend(loc=1, fontsize=8)
```
